label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the town hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 loaves on four great-hall tables and installed lanterns. Builder explicitly requested not telling the mayor; baker pursued coordination, with innkeeper and freight subsequently reported supplying bread. The mayor was informed by day 0, 14:19, so secrecy did not persist. A celebration of his forty years of service is plausible but not established; suppliers' knowledge of the secrecy is not directly established.
